title: Ashmita Chaliha Wins Maiden BWF World Tour Title in Korea Masters
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha achieved a significant milestone by securing her first BWF World Tour title.
summary: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha, 26, made a remarkable comeback from a serious knee injury suffered in 2024 to win her first BWF World Tour title at the Korea Masters.

title: Ayush Shetty Prepares for World No. 1 Clash After Asia Silver
indian_angle: Young Indian talent Ayush Shetty faces a major test against the world's top player, marking a significant moment in his burgeoning career.
summary: The 21-year-old Indian shuttler, fresh from an Asia silver medal, is set to face Chinese world No. 1 Shi Yu Qi in the first round of a tournament in New Delhi, approaching the challenge without fear.

title: India Hires 'Monkey Whisperers' for BWF World Championships Security
indian_angle: India's unique and costly preparations for hosting the BWF World Championships highlight the country's commitment to the event.
summary: Organizers for the BWF World Championships in India are employing 'monkey whisperers' to deter macaques and pigeons from the venue, a unique measure costing ₹20 crore.

title: PV Sindhu Reacts to 'Monkey Whisperers' at BWF Worlds in Delhi
indian_angle: India's badminton superstar PV Sindhu offers her perspective on the unusual security measures at the upcoming BWF World Championships in Delhi.
summary: Indian badminton star PV Sindhu shares her amused reaction to the news of organizers hiring men to mimic langur calls to deter macaque intruders from the BWF World Championships venue in Delhi.
